summary.headline: Astrological Questions 98–111
summary.text: Catalog of astrological questions 98–111, covering war and the power of stars from exaltation, death and inheritance inquiries, long journeys and travelers, royal action, negotiated profit or loss, hope, a friend’s opinion, and release from prison, with cross-references to Greek and Latin manuscripts.
